title: Recommender regret for improving regularised RL estimation with bandits and MCTS
abstract: arXiv:2610.32910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms rely on estimators, like Monte Carlo tree search or one-step look-ahead, to provide policy, value, or Q-value estimates in training and inference. However, existing bandit-based estimation frameworks evaluate sampling efficiency, not the quality of estimates. We address this by formalising estimate generation as a recommendation process, treating bandit-based sampling as an improvement operator. To evaluate the quality of a recommendation (estimate), we define regulariser-aware recommender regrets, analysing their lower bounds, and proving that simple algorithms like uniform sampling can achieve these bounds. Finally, we unify bandit- and search-based target improvement under recommender MCTS. translated_title: 用于通过老虎机与蒙特卡洛树搜索改进正则化强化学习估计的推荐者遗憾
translated_abstract: 正则化强化学习（RL）算法依赖于蒙特卡洛树搜索或单步前瞻等估计器，在训练和推理过程中提供策略、价值或Q值估计。然而，现有的基于老虎机的估计框架评估的是采样效率，而非估计的质量。我们通过将估计生成形式化为一个推荐过程来解决这一问题，将基于老虎机的采样视为一种改进算子。为了评估推荐（估计）的质量，我们定义了正则化感知的推荐者遗憾，分析了其下界，并证明了像均匀采样这样简单的算法也能达到这些下界。最后，我们在推荐者MCTS框架下统一了基于老虎机和基于搜索的目标改进方法。在合成树、街机游戏和科学发现任务中，推荐者通常能带来更快的目标收敛和更优的下游性能。我们的实验刻画了……
tldr: 该论文将基于老虎机的估计生成形式化为推荐过程，提出正则化感知的推荐者遗憾来评估估计质量并证明其下界，进而通过推荐者MCTS统一了基于老虎机和搜索的目标改进方法，在多种任务中实现了更快收敛与更优的下游性能。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes estimate generation as a recommendation process, introduces regulariser-aware recommender regrets to assess estimate quality with proven lower bounds, and unifies bandit- and search-based target improvement under recommender MCTS, achieving faster convergence and superior downstream performance across diverse tasks.
